finding: Bayesian network conditions incomplete stock properties to infer material/year/area probabilities. Reusable-component quantities and embodied-carbon estimates are future extensions, not implemented downstream outputs. Useful upstream uncertainty representation; no demonstrated S4-to-S5 transfer.
title: Probabilistic modelling of building stock properties for urban mining

evidence_level: targeted fulltext methods and system-boundary check
finding: Monte Carlo earthquake occurrence feeds damage-dependent renovation versus demolition/rebuilding and annual GWP/cost accumulation. End-of-life includes steel reuse credits; operational energy is excluded. This confirms uncertainty transfer to S5 outcomes through retention/replacement choices, but not a model of uncertain recovered-material quality or reuse yield. Interpret as a building-retention bridge, not complete material-chain tracking.
title: Probabilistic life-cycle assessment of service life extension on renovated buildings under seismic hazard

evidence_level: author conference presentation, not article fulltext
finding: Author slides show uncertain material service life and system parameters passed through LCA/LCC and polynomial-chaos surrogates to response distributions and Sobol indices. Supports S5 uncertainty propagation. Slides are supplementary evidence and cannot substitute for verification of the article; no recovered-material S4-to-S5 chain established.
title: Probabilistic LCA and LCC to identify robust and reliable renovation strategies
